articles.summary: Returnless refunds are reshaping e‑commerce: Amazon, Walmart, Target, Shein, and Temu let customers keep items while issuing full refunds. Discover why retailers adopt this strategy, its impact on CX, costs, fraud, and how REVER helps brands manage returnless workflows at scale.
articles.title: Returnless Refunds: How E‑Commerce Leaders Are Adopting the Trend — A Complete Guide
